All followed episodes are watched in time, at a total cost of **$34.96** (one Pebble Kids month at $7.99 and three Tidewell months at $8.99 each).

**Starting position.** On Nov 1–3, Pebble Kids, Orbit and Northline are all already paid. That exceeds the limit of 2, so no new access can start before Nov 4. Orbit and Northline carry no followed titles, so they are left to lapse.

**Pebble Kids (The Glass Atlas, all 7 episodes drop on 2026-11-22).**
- The tightest window is Leah's, which is Nov 22–23.
- One period starting 2026-11-22 covers Leah, Theo and Wen for every episode.
- That period runs to Dec 22 (exclusive).

**Tidewell (The Copper Kingdom, The Northern Circuit, Copper Lantern).** Eli's 2-day windows for The Copper Kingdom are the tightest constraint. Three periods with short gaps cover everything:

| Period | Access | What it covers |
|---|---|---|
| Starts 2026-12-22 | Dec 22 – Jan 21 | Copper Kingdom episodes Dec 21 (watched Dec 22, inside Eli's window), Dec 28, Jan 4, Jan 11 and Jan 18 |
| Starts 2027-01-26 | Jan 26 – Feb 25 | Copper Kingdom Jan 25 (watched Jan 26), Feb 1, Feb 8, Feb 15, Feb 22; Northern Circuit Jan 30 – Feb 20; Copper Lantern (window opens Feb 25) |
| Starts 2027-03-02 | Mar 2 – Apr 1 | Copper Kingdom Mar 1 (watched Mar 2) and Mar 8; Northern Circuit Feb 27 (Wen's window runs to Mar 5) through Mar 27 |

- No episode is released during either gap.
- Paying for continuous access from Dec 21 instead would take 4 months, so the gaps save one Tidewell payment.

**Rule checks.**
- At most 2 non-required services ever have access on the same day. Pebble's period ends on Dec 22, the same day Tidewell's first period begins.
- No periods of the same service overlap, and none overlaps already-paid access.
- All start dates fall within the plan dates.
